text: Hi, you've reached M Law Firm. I'm Maya. How can I help? Of course, take your time. Can I start with your name, and the best number to reach you?
instruction: An adult female receptionist with a gentle, smooth mid-low voice and a natural New York American accent. Calm, friendly, quietly confident. Speak as if responding to a real caller, thinking as you talk. Easy contractions, natural breathing, flowing phrases with little pauses between thoughts, soft falling inflections. Warm concern without theatrical emotion, a relaxed unforced smile. Clear everyday conversation, not narration, not over-enunciated, not whispering. Clean recording.
